    People also ask
    Which holidays is Costco closed?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Costco warehouses in the U.S. are closed on seven major holidays: New Year’s Day, Easter Sunday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day. These closures apply nationwide, although locations may have special operating hours on other holidays, such as Christmas Eve. 
    Costco Closed Holidays (U.S.): 
    • New Year's Day: January 1
    • Easter Sunday: Varies
    • Memorial Day: Last Monday in May
    • Independence Day: July 4
    • Labor Day: First Monday in September
    • Thanksgiving Day: Fourth Thursday in November
    • Christmas Day: December 25 
    Important Notes: 
    • Costco Business Centers: Closed on the same seven holidays, and they do not offer delivery on these days.
    • Christmas Eve/New Year's Eve: Typically open with early closing hours.
    • Other Holidays: Costco is generally open on holidays like Presidents Day, MLK Jr. Day, Columbus Day, and Veterans Day. 
    Always confirm with your local store using the Costco store locator as hours can vary.
